README.md.name: Legacy workflow guide
README.md.description: Describes the Python 2 collection then OAuth reporting sequence; historical setup is not validated today.

youtube.py.name: Channel ID scraper and SQLite writer
youtube.py.description: Uses requests and a regex against a legacy gdata uploads feed, inserts video IDs into SQLite, commits and closes when main completes.

youtube_sample.py.name: Per-video OAuth analytics report
youtube_sample.py.description: Builds OAuth API clients, loads IDs from SQLite, requests report metrics and prints headers/rows. Runtime API compatibility and its final counter expression are unverified.

fweeks.py.name: Incomplete date-window experiment
fweeks.py.description: Contains OAuth client setup and a channel request but ends at an incomplete with sqlite3.connect() statement. Not a runnable workflow.

video_picker.py.name: Incomplete interactive report selector
video_picker.py.description: Prompts for report type with Python 2 syntax, calls undefined/incompletely defined handlers and leaves the per-video loop without a body. Not a working CLI.
